plan.name: Have plumbing plans and builds keep SPEC.md and the README right
plan.summary: D-0122 has SPEC.md and the README describe Invariant as it is, but #134, #135 and #139 each changed what SPEC says without their plans naming it, so a plumbing plan's prompt and its build's prompt each gain one paragraph that says how to keep them right. formalize.PlanPrompt's goes under "Write the plan", just before "Keep the change small enough to review": "SPEC.md and the README describe Invariant as it is, and a change that makes either one wrong fixes it in the same change (D-0122). When yours does, name that file among the plan's files, and say in the summary what changes there. A new or changed SPEC bullet cites the decisions it rests on, as `decisions check` requires. A plumbing build can't write decisions/, so when the change needs a decision no one has recorded yet, say so in the summary, and whoever merges it records the decision." plumbing.BuildPrompt's goes after its four steps: "SPEC.md and the README describe Invariant as it is (D-0122). When the plan names either one, change it as the plan's summary says. A new or changed SPEC bullet cites the decisions it rests on, as `decisions check` requires, and only decisions already recorded, since you can't write decisions/. When the change needs a decision no one has recorded yet, say so when you stop, and whoever merges it records the decision." SPEC.md gains a sub-bullet under the plumbing bullet, after the one on the build's agent: "A plan's prompt and its build's tell their agents that SPEC.md and the README describe Invariant as it is. A plan names either one among its files when its change makes it wrong, and its summary says what changes there. A new or changed SPEC bullet cites the decisions it rests on. The build can't write `decisions/`, so a plan whose change needs a decision no one has recorded yet says so, and whoever merges it records it. `D-0122`" The README says nothing this changes, and the review prompt stays as it is. The change rests on D-0122, so it needs no new decision, and it changes the trusted base, so a person merges it.

tests.name: TestPlanningTellsTheAgentToKeepTheSpecAndReadmeRight
tests.says: A plumbing issue's planning prompt, for a draft and for a revision, says SPEC.md and the README describe Invariant as it is: a change that makes either one wrong fixes it in the same change, so the plan names that file among its files and says in its summary what changes there, a new or changed SPEC bullet cites the decisions it rests on, as `decisions check` requires, and since a plumbing build can't write decisions/, a change that needs a decision no one has recorded yet says so, and whoever merges it records the decision. It still gives the agent its checks.

tests.name: TestBuildTellsTheAgentToKeepTheSpecAndReadmeRight
tests.says: For a plan that names SPEC.md, the build's prompt says SPEC.md and the README describe Invariant as it is: when the plan names either one, the agent changes it as the plan's summary says, a new or changed SPEC bullet cites the decisions it rests on, as `decisions check` requires, and only decisions already recorded, since the build can't write decisions/, and when the change needs a decision no one has recorded yet, the agent says so, and whoever merges it records the decision. It still lists SPEC.md among the files the agent may write, and gives it its test runs.
